name: Weazel's Crater
summary: Weazel's Crater is a deep gouge carved into the hard salt of the northern Shimmering Flats. Its origins are mysterious, and Saltstone basilisks inhabit the hollow.

sections.title: A Volatile Legacy
sections.body: Across the blinding white expanse of the Shimmering Flats, experimental goblin and gnome rocket-cars constantly push the boundaries of mechanical sanity. Debris, scorched earth, and impact hollows litter the plains, but Weazel's Crater stands out for its sheer size and depth. The crater's origins are unknown. Today, the mechanical wreckage has largely settled, and the hollow has been claimed as a sunning pit by aggressive Saltstone basilisks.

aliases: why is there a crater here
faq.answer: The crater's origins are unknown. No cause is established.

faq.q: What lives in the crater now?
faq.answer: The depression is currently inhabited by dangerous Saltstone basilisks, which lurk along the rocky edges and bottom of the pit.

angles.text: The deep hollow lies amid the experimental racing machines and debris of the Shimmering Flats. Engineers visiting the speedway have good reason to study the hazardous terrain.
